Title: Email verification on account creation
Preconditions: Admin logged in to Backend and Storefront ({{BACK_URL}}, {{FRONT_URL}}). Store setting **Stores.EmailVerificationEnabled=true** on the target store — this is the flag that gates SENDING the verification email. Stores.EmailVerificationRequired is a DIFFERENT flag that gates BLOCKING sign-in for an unverified user; it is NOT required for the auto-send to fire. On this environment the storefront store has Enabled=true, Required=false (flow = EmailVerificationOptional), and the email is still sent.
Steps:
--- LAYER: Admin SPA - Security blade ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{BACK_URL}} > Settings > Security > Users
[ACT] Click 'Create' to open the new user form
[WAIT] new user form opens
[ACT] Fill required fields, including a valid email, for the new account
[SAVE] Click 'Create' to save the new account
[WAIT] account creation confirmed
--- LAYER: Admin SPA - Contacts blade ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{BACK_URL}} > Customer module > Contacts
[ACT] Click 'Add' to open the new contact form
[WAIT] new contact form opens
[ACT] Fill required fields (valid email, linked account) for the new contact
[SAVE] Click 'Create' to save the new contact
[WAIT] contact creation confirmed
--- LAYER: Storefront registration ---
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-up
[ACT] Fill the registration form with a valid email
[ACT] Click 'Create Account'
[WAIT] registration confirmed
Assertions:
[EMAIL] a verification email is sent for account creation via the Security blade, the Contacts blade, and Storefront registration, when Stores.EmailVerificationEnabled=true {OBSERVED} (setting values read live 2026-07-30: storefront store Enabled=true, Required=false)
[STATE] sending is gated by Stores.EmailVerificationEnabled — NOT by Stores.EmailVerificationRequired. The two form a two-bit flow selector: !Enabled => NoEmailVerification; Enabled && !Required => EmailVerificationOptional; Enabled && Required => EmailVerificationRequired {SPEC} (vc-module-profile-experience-api Extensions/StoreExtensions.cs GetEmailVerificationFlow; RegisterRequestCommandHandler.cs)
[STATE] with Enabled=true and Required=false the account is created EmailConfirmed=false and sign-in is NOT blocked — blocking additionally requires Required=true {SPEC} (vc-module-x-api ContactSignInValidator.cs)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings/Stores.EmailVerificationRequired confirms the setting reads true before the three creation sub-flows run
[ADMIN] Notifications > activity feed shows a sent verification notification for each of the three created accounts
Failure_Signals: No verification notification appears in the activity feed after account creation, Stores.EmailVerificationRequired reads false when the precondition expected true (setup drift), account creation itself fails before the verification-send step is reached
Cleanup: [SAVE] Delete the three test accounts/contacts created in Steps via Admin (Security/Contacts blades) or REST DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/members?ids=<id> for each
References: C278784 C278781 C278785 | Synced: VCST-5281 (2026-07-30) -- added the Stores.EmailVerificationRequired precondition (previously unstated), tagged Steps, and authored provenance-tagged assertions based on the live-confirmed auto-send mechanism. | Phase-5 verified 2026-07-30: REFUTED the precondition — the auto-send gate is Stores.EmailVerificationEnabled, not Stores.EmailVerificationRequired. Live values on the storefront store: Enabled=true, Required=false.
